title: ui: follow-ups of the dataset caller arm (#32311) — stale 32077 BREAKING line, the colour-probe guard pin, ReportView drill bare read
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-lizheng · session_012MmDsRT6hvZsQH9dTzn4CA

Follow-up of #32311 / PR #32629, from the epic red-line read 6827072400 (`epic:#31527#1`, PASS-with-nits at `e0d3c546d`). Nit 1 (the changeset sentence about the date range) is fixed in PR #32629 itself; nits 6 and 7 are seat bookkeeping, done there.

Parked per the epic release-line ruling 6824949405 / 6825014736 (review follow-up cards are parked).
Restart-when: the release that carries the epic #31527 release line is published (ruling on #31527, 6824949405)

## Items

1. **The pending `32077-dataset-query-package` changeset's BREAKING TO-line goes stale once PR #32629 lands.** That line refuses, with `not-held-by-qualifier`, a package item whose dataset only a dependency holds; after #32629 that case is served. Amend the TO-line as a DELIBERATE CORRECTION, naming `outside-closure` as the residual break, before the release cut that consumes both. If a release cuts between the two, drop this item. (Epic nit 2.)
2. **The colour probe's non-2xx guard has no test that tells it apart.** `ObjectChart.tsx` ~669: the dev's ablation A10 stayed green because an ADR-0112 409 envelope names no object. Add a pin whose refused response *would* be drawn without the guard. (Epic nit 4.)
3. **`handleDatasetDrill` in app-shell `ReportView.tsx` still reads the dataset bare on the old-server branch** (no drill metadata). It is dormant against current servers. Either send `callerPackage` there too, or delete the branch if no supported server takes it. (Epic nit 5; PR #32629 Acceptance notes.)

Out of the card: epic nit 3 (a server older than #32310 drops `?callerPackage=`) is not an issue against current `main`.
